questions.prompt: How should consumers trigger this workflow?
questions.description: The user said merges to main, but we need the workflow_call contract shape.
questions.recommendedAnswer: workflow_call + workflow_dispatch; each consumer has its own caller workflow that runs on push to main and passes Railway project/service settings, and the reusable workflow also supports manual triggers.

options.label: Also trigger on push to main inside this repo (not consumer)

questions.prompt: Railway's CLI cannot do a true image+variable rollback; it can only redeploy a previous deployment ID (rebuilds) or restart the current one. What should 'rollback' mean here?
questions.description: Dashboard rollback restores the previous image and variables instantly. CLI redeploy rebuilds from the previous deployment's source.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Redeploy the previous successful deployment via `railway redeploy --deployment <id>` (acceptable rebuild) and document that it is not a zero-downtime dashboard rollback.

options.label: Use Railway GraphQL/API for true image+variable rollback (more complex)
Only restart current deployment (not really rollback)
Fail the workflow but do not roll back; require manual dashboard action

questions.prompt: Which Railway inputs should the reusable workflow require from each consumer?
questions.description: Per AGENTS.md, every workflow_call input must have a type and either a default or required: true.
questions.recommendedAnswer: railway-token (secret), project (required string), service (required string), environment (optional string default 'production'), smoke-command (optional string default 'test:e2e:smoke').

questions.prompt: How should the smoke tests discover the URL of the newly deployed service?
questions.description: Smoke needs to hit the deployed service. Options range from consumer-provided to CLI-discovered.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Workflow discovers it via `railway domain --json` or `railway variables --json` after deployment, with an optional override input for consumers that need one.

options.label: Discover via Railway CLI after deploy
Consumer passes the URL as an input
Smoke script reads URL from an environment variable set by the consumer workflow

questions.prompt: What defines a successful deployment before smoke tests run?
questions.description: Railway deployments move through BUILDING, DEPLOYING, INITIALIZING, SUCCESS, etc. We can wait on CLI or poll.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Run `railway up --detach`, capture the new deployment ID from JSON output, then poll `railway deployment list --json` until status is SUCCESS or a timeout is reached.

options.label: Run attached `railway up` and rely on exit code 0
Detach, then poll deployment list until SUCCESS
Wait for HTTP health endpoint to return 200

questions.prompt: What should the required check name be for branch protection?
questions.description: Check names are a public API per AGENTS.md; consumers will require them in branch protection.
